mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, title, emotion, emotion_label, content, images, source, source_diary_id, like_count, comment_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{emotion}, #{emotionLabel}, #{content}, #{images}, #{source}, #{sourceDiaryId}, 0, 0, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, emotion, emotion_label, content, images, like_count, comment_count, source, source_diary_id, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM post WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id, title, emotion, emotion_label, content, images, like_count, comment_count, source, source_diary_id, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id, title, emotion, emotion_label, content, images, like_count, comment_count, source, source_diary_id, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND DATE(create_time) = #{date} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, user_id, title, emotion, emotion_label, content, images, like_count, comment_count, source, source_diary_id, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM post WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET is_deleted = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE post SET like_count = like_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND like_count > 0
UPDATE post SET comment_count = comment_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
